correctness.rationale: Assume exact Jiang–Lim–Parvatikar equality classification (orthogonal r-vector orthonormal remainder plus m=n-d centered regular simplices of positive even dimensions k_i). For each k-simplex block, pair inner products -1/k imply squared signed-sum norm ((k+1)^2-s^2)/k and maximal k+2; with |s|=2t+1 the defect is 4t(t+1)/k of multiplicity 2 binom(k+1,k/2-t). Orthogonal blocks yield exact convolution and 2^r multiplicity factor. Largest block K has uniquely least positive defect 8/K, first-positive-to-zero multiplicity q K/(K+4) where q largest blocks: this exactly recovers K,q. Positive finite Laplace transforms permit exact division/cancellation and induction over remaining blocks; total mass 2^n and largest squared norm 2n-d recover n,d and r. Independently checked direct exact sign enumerations for simplex sizes 2 through 14 and the first positive defect ratios. Edge m=0 has only constant spectrum and n=d, so is recovered directly. Finite check supports but does not prove infinite theorem; the analytic inverse argument does.
